GAP, one cause (pit wall #5429, #5437, #5439): section edges are scaled by each lap's measured distance, and the game file's 10 Hz distance reads laps up to 5.6 m short, so edges late in the lap move ~5 m (0.1-0.2 s, a few km/h). Fix: edges and grid from the curated map's metres (SESSION_PIPELINE, the gridN precondition); then these three entries go. Bounds are the measured worst on the two pairs (6 m: 5.6; 0.25 s: 0.21; 2.5 km/h: 1.9), split by unit
